text:
ian: hitting weird behavior in rust sdk onboarding cli. batched embeddings (batch=5) sometimes come back with a null in the middle when token refresh happens. repro in repo: https://gist.github.com/repro-rust-embed

meera: can you paste the minimal request/response? is it missing an entry or shuffled?

ian: minimal: POST /v1/embeddings body: {inputs:[p1,p2,p3,p4,p5]} response.data: [e1, e2, null, e4, e5] where e3 is null. dims appear correct for others (1536).

tony: sounds like a mapping-by-position bug if a retry requeues part of the batch. which sdk version?

ian: rust-sdk v0.6.2. behavior doesn't happen in python sampleapp. suspect parity gap in batcher implementation.

meera: rust batcher uses a single Vec to collect callers and maps responses by slice index at resolution time. if a refresh or partial retry splits the slice, offsets can drift. python and go map by per-item token.

tony: two orthogonal problems we saw across runtimes: 1) mapping by index leads to null/duplicate slots when retries occur; 2) response envelope key varies: some runtimes return data[i].embedding, others data[i].vector or data[i].embeddings. sampleapps brittle.

ian: short-term for CLI quickstart: set EMBED_BATCH=1 in env and add note to onboarding README. That prevented the nulls in local repro.

meera: longer-term fix options: a) inject per-item metadata.item_key (UUID) into request and expect server echo in response.data[*].item_key so client can map; b) server-side: if partial success happens, return per-item statuses (207) or include response.metadata.map to indicate mapping. c) normalize envelope key to singular embedding across runtimes.

tony: I prefer (a) to ship quickly. (b) is more breaking and takes more server work. Also add client defensive check: if any data[i] is null, raise structured error instead of returning null silently.

ian: I'll open rust-sdk PR to map by item_key and add preserve_ids config flag (default off for compatibility). will add unit+integration that simulates a token refresh mid-batch.

sdk-bot: CI: rust-sdk PR #204 created; job 12844 queued.

meera: also file a docs note: onboarding troubleshooting -> "If you see missing or duplicated embeddings, try EMBED_BATCH=1 and disable client retry; we are fixing mapping in SDKs."

tony: filed GH issue: redwood/rust-sdk#204 (onboarding: embed batch mapping + envelope parity) with repro and logs. linking here.

ian: thanks team. catching this in DX before more users hit the quickstart is huge. will ping once PR is ready for review. :rocket:
